table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		 patient = Max(patient.name) ,
		 customer  = Max(dbo.accounts.name),	
		 employeename = Max(patient.employeename),
		 regno = Max(patient.regno) ,
		 rank = Max(rank.name),  
		 unit = Max(unit.name),
		 relationship = ( Select Name From Relation Where Relationcode = Max(patient.relationcode)  ),
		 room = ( Select Name From Ward Where wardcode = Max(patient.wardcode)  ),
		 consultant = ( Select Name From Doctors Where doctcode = Max(patient.doctcode)  ),
		date = Convert( VarChar(12), dbo.saleledger.date, 103 ),
	    	looseqty = Sum(saledetail.looseqty),
       	unitprice = Max(SaleDetail.saleprice),
		purunitrate = Max(SaleDetail.purunitrate),
       	itemname=(CASE WHEN max(SaleDetail.SaleItemDescription) IS NULL OR max(SaleDetail.SaleItemDescription)='' THEN item.name ELSE max(SaleDetail.SaleItemDescription) END)

FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 	dbo.saledetail,    
			dbo.customer,
			dbo.accounts,
		 	dbo.item,
   	 		dbo.patient,
		 	dbo.rank,
		 	dbo.unit

WHERE  dbo.saleledger.date Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate  AND
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
          dbo.accounts.acccode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
		 dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND
		 dbo.patient.patientcode = :ai_patientcode AND
		 dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode AND
		 dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode AND
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND  
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode 

GROUP BY 	Convert( VarChar(12), dbo.saleledger.date, 103 ),
					dbo.item.name
